sources: Navigator. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_pistol_0005 (weapon skill 3, SkillPatchTable: crit_up, dmg_up, crit_up2, duration): cardAttributeModifier attr 9 (Critical Rate) +crit_up (stat panel, with skills 1 and 2: Intellect, Cryo DMG); `buffs` -> buff_wpn_pistol_0005 (permanent AuraAction, radius 40, on enemies) -> buff_wpn_pistol_0005_inaura on each enemy in it: abilityEvent 205 (a buff added to the aura holder, from anyone) + tag Solidification (1535684437) or Corrosion (-421286163): CheckTargetsEqual (the wielder caused it) -> CreateBuff buff_wpn_pistol_0005_valid on the wielder with dmg_up and crit_up2 x multi 2, else (NotNext) the plain one. buff_wpn_pistol_0005_valid: attr 53 (Cryo DMG) and 54 (Nature DMG) +dmg_up, attr 9 (Critical Rate) +crit_up2, `duration`; stackingType 1 with priority key dmg_up (instances compete, the strongest acts: 'Effects of the same name cannot stack'), maxStackCntKey max_stack, which sk_wpn_pistol_0005 doesn't have (B2: no limit). toggleBuffs buff_wpn_lance_0003 (CheckCurHpRatio hp_ratio, a key the skill lacks: a copied leftover, left out). "When Solidification or Corrosion is applied to enemies, the wielder gains Cryo DMG Dealt and Nature DMG Dealt +{dmg_up}, and Critical Rate +{crit_up2} for {duration}s. If this effect is triggered by the wielder, double the increase gained." Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0017_yvonne.md rows W1-W3.
